record.paper: Product structure of graph classes with strongly sublinear separators

dossier_meta.paper: Product structure of graph classes with strongly sublinear separators
dossier_meta.statement_text: For any hereditary graph class $\mathcal{G}$ with separation-number $\operatorname{sep}(\mathcal{G})\in O(n^{1-\epsilon})$, does there exist a constant $c=c(\mathcal{G})$ such that every $n$-vertex graph $G\in\mathcal{G}$ is contained in $H\boxtimes K_m$, where $\operatorname{tw}(H)\leqslant c$ and $m\in O(n^{1-\epsilon})$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Open Problem 6 is the only explicitly labeled open-problem environment in the paper (LaTeX environment type [open]). It appears between Theorem 5 and Theorem 7, in the context of product structure theory for graph classes with strongly sublinear separators.
